Flow Clone

Everything runs on this PC. Nothing is sent over the network.

Shortcuts

Keys: Ctrl, Win, Alt, Shift, Space, Esc, A–Z, 0–9, F1–F24. Max 3 keys, at least one modifier.

Audio
Speech model

Checking…

A whisper.cpp ggml model, e.g. ggml-base.bin (default) or ggml-small-q5_1.bin for better accuracy. Models are never downloaded automatically: put the file in .

Transcription

After a paste the field is re-read for about 45 s. Words you fix show up under Dictionary → Suggestions; nothing is added without your OK.

AI cleanup (local LLM)

Off.

Removes fillers, applies "scratch that" and spoken lists, and adapts tone per app. Runs llama.cpp on this PC ( next to the app). Off: deterministic formatting only. If the model is slow, the plain transcript is pasted instead.

Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct Q4_K_M is the fast default; Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct is more accurate and about twice as slow. Never downloaded automatically.

Which style applies depends on the app you dictate into.
